The process

Four steps
to your ride.

01

Choose your service

Six tailored services for every kind of journey — from airport runs to week-long tours. Pick exactly what you need.

02

Browse verified cars

Every car and driver is manually approved by our team. Location-matched. Documents verified. No compromises.

03

Pay 20% to confirm

Secure your booking with just 20% advance via bKash or SSLCommerz. The rest is paid directly to your driver.

04

Ride & review

Your driver arrives on time. After the trip, rate your experience. Your feedback keeps the platform trustworthy.
